A nasty-looking [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] '''criminal''' worked in partnership with a crime syndicate [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|courier]].

The two often visiting the [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Drev'starn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and often stayed in a [[Bothan hotel]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the Rodian ran afoul of another criminal gang, which aimed to steal the contents of a briefcase in the possession of the courier, and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

His body was hidden under a room service cart, and was spotted by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s (coincidentally, [[Unidentified courier lookalike|one of them]] was a perfect lookalike of the Rodian's partner). In his body they found a late night reservation for the ''[[Stone Grotto]]'' for the very evening he was killed.

{{Char-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
The game scenario allows some choices about the detective's involvement in the case; it is up to the Rebel players whether they mention the body to the detective, or distract/get rid of him. If the detective is aware of the body, he will tag along in order to be led to the culprit.

The suggested scenario does not resolve the Rodian's murder; the detective might pin the murder on the gang of Rodians who later attempted to kidnap the courier in the Stone Grotto. It allows the possibility for the Rodian partner to be double dealing, and having being murdered by the [[Unidentified man (gravely voice)|gravely voiced human]] as a warning.
